faqItems.a: Yes, booking a tee time is mandatory. This can be done online via our booking system or by phone.
Free cancellation up to 48 hours before your tee time. After that, a 50% cancellation fee applies.
Yes, buggies and trolleys are available for hire from the pro shop. Golf sets are available on request.

club.title: The Club
club.subtitle: A rich golfing tradition since 1908
club.historyText: Royal Zoute Golf Club was founded in 1908 in the prestigious coastal town of Knokke. Our iconic clubhouse 'Villa Magere Schorre' has welcomed members and guests for over a century. The club received its royal designation and has grown to become one of the most respected golf clubs in Belgium and Europe.
club.clubhouseText: Villa Magere Schorre, our English-style clubhouse, is an architectural gem that perfectly reflects the elegance and tradition of the club.

hotel.title: Boutique Hotel

hotel.description: Stay in our historic villa and enjoy exclusive benefits as a hotel guest, including a complimentary green fee per night.

restaurant.description: Our restaurant offers seasonal dishes prepared with local produce, with beautiful views over the golf course. The bistro is open to all visitors.
